concordance_gate_reference.note: Included as reference only; this artifact does not rewire policy or thresholds.

class_conditional_trust.flavin: discounted unless existing raw-fusion target recovery or motif plus local/role support is present
class_conditional_trust.heme: discounted unless existing raw-fusion target recovery or motif plus local/role support is present
class_conditional_trust.metal_ion: trusted when M-Ionic >= 0.95; used as the broadest cofactor evidence source
class_conditional_trust.no_required_cofactor: allowed only for ser_his_acid_hydrolase with low metal score and no organic motif conflict
class_conditional_trust.plp: discounted; no PLP expansion without local support or persisted high-confidence sequence evidence

decision_rule: Accept the five preregistered raw-fusion target-recovery rows already persisted by the existing fusion summary.
Otherwise accept metal_dependent_hydrolase only when predicted geometry is nonabstained and M-Ionic metal score >= 0.95.
Accept ser_his_acid_hydrolase only as a no-required-cofactor call when M-Ionic < 0.5 and no organic motif proxy fires.

Accept organic-cofactor calls only with motif plus local/role cofactor support; with AF predicted structures and missing ESM per-entry rows this accepts no broad organic expansion beyond the persisted target rescues.

flavin.allowed_use_without_policy_change: keep existing preregistered/local-role supported target rescues; do not broaden thresholds
basis: selected ESM aggregate reliability is strong: ROC AUC 0.918622 and AP 0.732961 on 11 heldout positives
fixed 0.5 selected-source threshold still has 5 FP and 4 FN, so broad autonomous expansion is not clean
selected ESM per-entry rows are not retained in this frozen snapshot; row-level audit falls back to k-mer control and local ligand rows

heme.allowed_use_without_policy_change: retain only local/role supported or already persisted target rescues; keep broad heme expansion discounted
basis: selected ESM aggregate ROC AUC is 0.866154, but AP is 0.525794 with only 5 heldout positives
fixed 0.5 selected-source threshold has 5 FP against 3 TP
heme local context is easily confounded by metal/no-organic and dual-domain rows; no retained ESM rows exist for row attribution

metal_ion.allowed_use_without_policy_change: do not use M-Ionic alone as organic evidence; retain strict metal contrast behavior only
basis: M-Ionic rank metric is moderate: ROC AUC 0.781067 and AP 0.567376 on 29 heldout positives
M-Ionic alone at threshold 0.95 is not precise enough for standalone routing: 21 TP, 34 FP, 8 FN
existing concordance policy adds route/geometry constraints and is outside this no-rewire diagnostic
metal_ion.trust_for_concordance_gating: trusted only when combined with existing route/geometry constraints

basis: empty local cofactor_families means no mapped local ligand in the selected experimental structure
it is not a guaranteed apo/no-cofactor biological assertion
use as a contrast for false-positive analysis and abstention pressure only

plp.allowed_use_without_policy_change: use as a reliability diagnostic; keep PLP discounted for concordance routing in this artifact
basis: selected ESM aggregate reliability is strongest: ROC AUC 0.990956 and AP 0.876623
support is small: 6 heldout positives and 24 train positives
concordance gate accepted no PLP rows in the frozen persisted policy, and selected per-entry ESM rows are unavailable for high-confidence row review

label_policy.no_organic_caveat: empty local cofactor_families means no mapped local cofactor ligand was observed in the selected experimental structure; it is not a guaranteed biological absence assertion
label_policy.positive_label_source: selected experimental PDB ligand_context.cofactor_families derived from HETATM/cofactor ligand codes proximal to active-site residues
